list.name: strategy

list.label: Strategy

list.name: symbol
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT symbol FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' ORDER BY 1
list.label: Symbol

list.name: obs_window
list.label: MFE/MAE Window
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT regexp_replace(column_name, '^mfe_', '')::int AS window FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='signal_outcomes' AND column_name LIKE 'mfe_%' ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Unrealized PnL
panels.description: Latest signal: (current_price - entry_price) / entry_price × signal_value. Sim only, N/A for backtest.

panels.title: Signals

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Signals" FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode' AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts)

panels.description: Total signal count in selected time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN sign(signal_value) = sign(fwd_return_24) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "WR" FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode' AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts) AND fwd_return_24 IS NOT NULL

panels.title: MFE (Avg)

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(mfe_24) AS "MFE" FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode' AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts) AND mfe_24 IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Mean Maximum Favorable Excursion within 24 bars. Higher = signal catches larger moves.

panels.title: MAE (Avg)

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(mae_24) AS "MAE" FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode' AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts) AND mae_24 IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Mean Maximum Adverse Excursion within 24 bars. Lower = cleaner entries.

panels.title: MFE/MAE

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(mfe_24) / NULLIF(AVG(mae_24), 0) AS "Ratio" FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode' AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts) AND mfe_24 IS NOT NULL AND mae_24 IS NOT NULL

panels.description: MFE_avg / MAE_avg. >2 = healthy edge. <1 = risk exceeds reward.

panels.title: Bars to MFE

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(bars_to_mfe) AS "Bars" FROM signal_outcomes WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode' AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts) AND bars_to_mfe IS NOT NULL

panels.description: Mean bars to reach MFE. Shorter = faster payoff, informs holding period.

panels.title: IC Around Event (T-6 to T+24)

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT signal_value,
    pre_return_6, pre_return_3, pre_return_1,
    fwd_return_1, fwd_return_6, fwd_return_12, fwd_return_24
  FROM signal_outcomes
  WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode'
    AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts)
    AND fwd_return_1 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 'T-6' AS horizon, corr(signal_value, pre_return_6) AS "IC" FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'T-3', corr(signal_value, pre_return_3) FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'T-1', corr(signal_value, pre_return_1) FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'T+1', corr(signal_value, fwd_return_1) FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'T+6', corr(signal_value, fwd_return_6) FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'T+12', corr(signal_value, fwd_return_12) FROM base
UNION ALL SELECT 'T+24', corr(signal_value, fwd_return_24) FROM base

panels.description: corr(signal_value, return) at each horizon. Pre-event IC > 0 suggests lagging signal (chasing price).

panels.title: Rolling IC ($window signals)

targets.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT signal_ts, signal_value, fwd_return_24,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts) AS rn
  FROM signal_outcomes
  WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode'
    AND fwd_return_24 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.signal_ts AS time,
  corr(b.signal_value, b.fwd_return_24) AS "Rolling IC"
FROM ranked a
JOIN ranked b ON b.rn BETWEEN a.rn - $window + 1 AND a.rn
WHERE a.rn >= $window
GROUP BY a.signal_ts, a.rn
ORDER BY a.signal_ts

panels.description: Rolling corr(signal_value, fwd_return_24). Typical crypto H1: 0.03-0.10. Sustained <0 = signal broken.

panels.title: Win Rate by Horizon

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT signal_value, fwd_return_1, fwd_return_6, fwd_return_12, fwd_return_24
  FROM signal_outcomes
  WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode'
    AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts) AND fwd_return_1 IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN sign(signal_value) = sign(fwd_return_1) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS wr1,
    AVG(CASE WHEN sign(signal_value) = sign(fwd_return_6) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS wr6,
    AVG(CASE WHEN sign(signal_value) = sign(fwd_return_12) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS wr12,
    AVG(CASE WHEN sign(signal_value) = sign(fwd_return_24) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS wr24
  FROM base
)
SELECT v.horizon, v."Win Rate"
FROM stats, LATERAL (
  VALUES ('T+1', wr1), ('T+6', wr6), ('T+12', wr12), ('T+24', wr24)
) AS v(horizon, "Win Rate")

panels.description: sign(signal_value) == sign(fwd_return) at T+1/6/12/24. Reveals optimal holding period.

panels.title: Rolling Win Rate ($window signals)

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT signal_ts,
    CASE WHEN sign(signal_value) = sign(fwd_return_24) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS win,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts) AS rn
  FROM signal_outcomes
  WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode'
    AND fwd_return_24 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT signal_ts AS time,
  AVG(win) OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts ROWS BETWEEN ($window - 1) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Win Rate"
FROM base
WHERE rn >= $window
ORDER BY signal_ts

panels.description: Rolling directional accuracy over $window signals. Typical: 40-55%. Drop below 35% = regime shift.

panels.title: Return per Bar (T-6 to T+24)
panels.description: Per-bar adjusted return (return/n) at each horizon. Normalized for cross-horizon comparison. Pre-event bars detect price chasing.

targets.rawSql:
WITH adj AS (
  SELECT
    signal_value * pre_return_6 / 6.0 AS r_neg6,
    signal_value * pre_return_3 / 3.0 AS r_neg3,
    signal_value * pre_return_1 / 1.0 AS r_neg1,
    signal_value * fwd_return_1 / 1.0 AS r1,
    signal_value * fwd_return_6 / 6.0 AS r6,
    signal_value * fwd_return_12 / 12.0 AS r12,
    signal_value * fwd_return_24 / 24.0 AS r24
  FROM signal_outcomes
  WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode'
    AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts) AND fwd_return_1 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 'T-6' AS horizon, AVG(r_neg6) AS "Mean",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r_neg6) AS "Median",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r_neg6) AS "P25",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r_neg6) AS "P75" FROM adj
UNION ALL
SELECT 'T-3', AVG(r_neg3),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r_neg3),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r_neg3),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r_neg3) FROM adj
UNION ALL
SELECT 'T-1', AVG(r_neg1),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r_neg1),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r_neg1),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r_neg1) FROM adj
UNION ALL
SELECT 'T+1', AVG(r1),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r1),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r1),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r1) FROM adj
UNION ALL
SELECT 'T+6', AVG(r6),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r6),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r6),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r6) FROM adj
UNION ALL
SELECT 'T+12', AVG(r12),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r12),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r12),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r12) FROM adj
UNION ALL
SELECT 'T+24', AVG(r24),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r24),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r24),
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r24) FROM adj

panels.title: Signal Equity Curve
panels.description: Cumulative PnL if entering every signal and holding for 1/6/12/24 bars. No SL/TP. Toggle horizons via legend.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT signal_ts,
    signal_value * fwd_return_1 AS r1,
    signal_value * fwd_return_6 AS r6,
    signal_value * fwd_return_12 AS r12,
    signal_value * fwd_return_24 AS r24
  FROM signal_outcomes
  WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode'
    AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts)
    AND fwd_return_1 IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY signal_ts
)
SELECT signal_ts AS time,
  SUM(r1) OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts) AS "Hold 1",
  SUM(r6) OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts) AS "Hold 6",
  SUM(r12) OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts) AS "Hold 12",
  SUM(r24) OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts) AS "Hold 24"
FROM base

panels.title: Rolling MFE p50 ($obs_window bars)

targets.rawSql:
WITH signals AS (
  SELECT signal_ts,
    mfe_24 AS mfe,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts) AS rn
  FROM signal_outcomes
  WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode' AND mfe_24 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.signal_ts AS time,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.mfe) AS "MFE p50"
FROM signals a
JOIN signals b ON b.rn BETWEEN a.rn - $window + 1 AND a.rn
WHERE a.rn >= $window
GROUP BY a.signal_ts, a.rn
ORDER BY a.signal_ts

panels.description: Rolling median MFE(24). Declining = shrinking opportunity, trend weakening.

panels.title: Rolling MAE p75/p95 ($obs_window bars)

targets.rawSql:
WITH signals AS (
  SELECT signal_ts,
    mae_24 AS mae,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts) AS rn
  FROM signal_outcomes
  WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode' AND mae_24 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.signal_ts AS time,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.mae) AS "MAE p75",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.mae) AS "MAE p95"
FROM signals a
JOIN signals b ON b.rn BETWEEN a.rn - $window + 1 AND a.rn
WHERE a.rn >= $window
GROUP BY a.signal_ts, a.rn
ORDER BY a.signal_ts

panels.description: Rolling 75th/95th percentile MAE(24). Rising = noisier entries, widen SL or pause.

panels.title: MFE/MAE Ratio ($obs_window bars)

targets.rawSql:
WITH signals AS (
  SELECT signal_ts,
    mfe_24 AS mfe,
    mae_24 AS mae,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts) AS rn
  FROM signal_outcomes
  WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode'
    AND mfe_24 IS NOT NULL AND mae_24 IS NOT NULL AND mae_24 > 0
)
SELECT a.signal_ts AS time,
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.mfe)
  / NULLIF(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.mae), 0) AS "MFE_p50 / MAE_p75",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.mfe)
  / NULLIF(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY b.mae), 0) AS "MFE_p50 / MAE_p95"
FROM signals a
JOIN signals b ON b.rn BETWEEN a.rn - $window + 1 AND a.rn
WHERE a.rn >= $window
GROUP BY a.signal_ts, a.rn
ORDER BY a.signal_ts

panels.description: Rolling MFE_p50/MAE_p75 (typical) and MFE_p50/MAE_p95 (conservative). >2 healthy, <1 not worth trading.

panels.title: Signal Density (rolling $window)

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT signal_ts,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM signal_ts - LAG(signal_ts) OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts)) / 3600.0 AS gap_hours,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts) AS rn
  FROM signal_outcomes
  WHERE strategy='$strategy' AND symbol='$symbol' AND source='$mode'
    AND $__timeFilter(signal_ts)
)
SELECT signal_ts AS time,
  AVG(gap_hours) OVER (ORDER BY signal_ts ROWS BETWEEN ($window - 1) PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "Avg Gap (hours)"
FROM base
WHERE rn >= $window AND gap_hours IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY signal_ts

panels.description: Rolling avg inter-signal gap (hours). Shrinking = choppy market (more false signals). Expanding = quiet or signal logic inactive.
